correction: The 0.6.2 pushes (48c2101, 9c7f3a4) obtained production.deploy ALLOW 2db3c26caa7dcf9b and f681d1933726b968 before moving main.
finding: Pushing main in zachshallbetter/cleanplate (8716c3d) and zachshallbetter/zachshallbetter.com (41201ee) started automatic Vercel production deploys without a separate production.deploy decision.
impact: Both deploys were Ready and both sites answered 200; the commits changed only bootstrap files.
lesson: In a repository that deploys main automatically, git.protected_ref.update on main is also a production deploy.

correction: 0.6.2 reads only files Git tracks or would add; clean-plate's 0.6.2 lock was generated from a clean checkout of its commit. Every 0.6.2 consumer commit validates from a clean worktree.
finding: The 0.6.1 consumer commits carried context locks generated from the working tree: git-ignored files (semantic-cms impl/editor/web/data.json) and uncommitted edits to tracked files (clean-plate tsconfig.json, tools/qa/validate_corpus.py) entered the corpus, so the locks did not match a clean checkout.
remaining: Uncommitted edits to tracked files still reach a working-tree lock; azimuth avoids this by compiling from the index.
